versions.changelog:
- Refined skill description to focus on read-only queries for seven core Cloud Connect (CC) resources, including detailed triggers and scenarios.
- Expanded documentation and added comprehensive usage guidance, workflow steps, explicit CLI examples, and parameter tables for each supported resource type.
- Clarified out-of-scope features, mapping unsupported operations to suggested hcloud CLI commands.
- Added prerequisites section covering CLI setup, AK/SK configuration, IAM permissions, and domain_id requirements.
- Emphasized domain_id handling and best practices to avoid cross-account confusion.
